item.title: SQLite Ships sqlite3_rsync for Remote Database Snapshot Copies
item.description:
SQLite's built-in sqlite3_rsync copies a database snapshot to a remote machine over SSH without first creating a full local duplicate, solving the backup problem on disk-constrained instances. It borrows rsync's page-hash comparison to transfer only differing pages, so syncing an existing replica avoids retransmitting the whole database.

原文标题：SQLite 推出 sqlite3_rsync 支持远程快照复制

Why it matters：为磁盘受限环境提供免全量副本的远程快照方案，对 SQLite 运维与备份实践有直接价值。

item.title: Alibaba XuanTie RISC-V Chips Ship 6 Billion Units as Android 17 Adds Support
item.description:
Alibaba DAMO Academy disclosed at ICCAD-Expo 2026 that cumulative shipments of its XuanTie RISC-V IP chips have surpassed 6 billion units across IoT, industrial control and automotive use cases, alongside the new ASIL-D-grade E908A core. More significantly, Android 17 now officially supports the RISC-V architecture; combined with fully ratified server-level extensions and a TORQ AI software stack supporting vLLM and SGLang, RISC-V is moving from embedded territory toward high-performance computing and AI-native workloads.

原文标题：阿里玄铁 RISC-V 芯片出货超 60 亿颗 安卓 17 正式支持

Why it matters：安卓 17 官方支持 RISC-V 叠加 60 亿颗出货量，是开放指令集进入主流智能终端与服务器市场的关键节点。

item.title: US Export Curbs Tighten Squeeze on Chinese AI Labs' Chips and Distillation
item.description:
The Information reports that a new US Commerce Department rule gives overseas data centers serving Chinese customers 90 days to obtain licenses, cutting off the main route to rented Blackwell chips; Moonshot AI has already scrapped a $150M Indonesian deal. Combined with narrowing access to distilling American models, DeepSeek researchers privately estimate the US frontier lead could widen from 3-6 months to about 9, with some fearing the gap may not be closed this time.

item.title: Kioxia and Nvidia Partner to Extend GPU Memory to Petabyte Scale
item.description:
Kioxia and Nvidia have launched a proof-of-concept on a GB200 NVL72 rack system equipped with 144 KIOXIA XD8 NVMe SSDs totaling roughly 1.1PB, combining them with Nvidia's SCADA software library to break past HBM memory limits via 512-byte granular random access to SSDs. The test targets a database of about 2 trillion vectors and also covers large-scale datasets used by graph neural networks.

原文标题：铠侠英伟达联手将 GPU 显存扩展至 PB 级

Why it matters：以 SSD 扩展 GPU 有效显存至 PB 级，直击 AI 推理与向量检索的内存墙瓶颈，是算力基础设施的重要探索方向。

item.title: Anthropic Cuts Riemann Hypothesis Proof Code by 99.5% Using Claude
item.description:
Anthropic researcher Luke Sernau and colleagues used Claude to rewrite and refactor a 17.4-million-line Lean formalization of the Riemann Hypothesis down to roughly 76,000 lines, a 99.56% reduction. The new version builds in one to two hours on an ordinary 12-core, 24GB machine, versus 21 hours on high-end AWS hardware for the original. The effort answers community criticism that the original proof was too large to verify.

原文标题：Anthropic 用 Claude 将黎曼猜想证明代码精简 99.5%

Why it matters：这是 AI 辅助大规模形式化数学工程的重要实践，展示了模型在代码重构与证明精简上的实际能力。

item.title: ChatGPT 聊天与工作模式合并计量 重度用户额度将更快耗尽

item.title: 约翰霍普金斯与 Together AI 研究发现高推理努力反而更差
item.description:
约翰霍普金斯大学与 Together AI 的新论文发现，提高推理努力（reasoning effort）并不总是更好：在低努力已能解决的任务上，高努力反而经常失败，尽管整体准确率上升。研究测试了 8 个模型（含 GPT-5.6、Claude Sonnet 5）在数学、科学、终端与编程基准上的各档努力水平，发现“先低努力、验证失败后再升级”的策略在所有模型上追平或超过固定最高努力，且 GPQA 成本中位数降低 41.5%。

Why it matters：该研究给出可立即落地的智能体成本优化策略，并揭示推理努力并非越高越好的反直觉结论。

item.title: 三星与 SK 海力士获长江存储 Xtacking 技术授权
item.description:

Why it matters：存储三巨头首次在核心堆叠架构上形成反向技术授权，是 NAND 竞争格局与知识产权版图的重要信号。
